title: Interactive Terminal
description: An interactive command-line interface for exploring projects, background, and developer systems. Built directly into the web portfolio.

welcome.title: Welcome to JsonDev Virtual Shell (bash simulation) [Version 1.2.0]

help.desc: List available commands and their usage.

pwd.desc: Print the simulated current working directory.

echo.desc: Print text or arguments to the terminal.

ls.desc: List virtual directory contents and files.

tree.desc: List virtual directory contents in a tree-like format.

about.desc: Display developer background and foundational overview.
about.location: Location: Manchester, United Kingdom (Open to Remote)
about.summary: Developer with operations background in estate care and high-volume customer service. Transitioned into software development via Harvard CS50x fundamentals, workflow automation (Python, VBA), and modern web interfaces (React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS). Bilingual in English and Spanish.

projects.desc: List public projects or show details with 'projects <slug>'.
projects.notFound: Project not found: "{{slug}}". Type "projects" to list supported slugs.

skills.desc: Display core technical stack, tooling, and competencies.
skills.languages: Languages & Core: JavaScript (ES6+), Python, C, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, VBA
skills.frameworks: Frameworks & UI: React, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Three.js
skills.foundations: Computer Science: Algorithms, Data Structures, Memory Management (Harvard CS50x)
skills.strengths: Operational Strengths: Bilingual (EN/ES), Workflow Automation, Process Improvement

contact.desc: Display verified direct contact channels and profiles.

history.desc: Show commands executed in the current session.
history.empty: No commands in current session history.

errors.notFoundHint: Type "help" for a list of available commands.
errors.empty: Please enter a command. Type "help" for guidance.
